refused.reader-disagreement-metric: content_f1 reaches 0.000 between clean readers (single-word and digit-only cases): any threshold above zero misses, and a threshold at zero fires on clean files — no value separates, so the metric form is not shipped; the page-empty form is deterministic and ships

rule: value = max(declared floor, clean-set maximum); a separation of at least 0.20 between the clean set and the planted set is required, and a signal that does not separate is refused and not shipped

lexical_min_runs.source: declared policy: a reading with fewer than 20 Arabic runs is not judged for lexical validity (it can be neither passed nor failed)

lexical_validity.source: derived: clean_set_minimum - 0.20 (the declared separation rule, with higher = better); the planted letter-swap file is the negative side and the two owner-adjudicated files (0.733 valid / 0.299 broken) bracket the floor

min_arabic_chars.source: arafix DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS["min_arabic_chars"] (MIT). Used twice, declared: (a) arafix does not judge orientation on a text with fewer Arabic characters, (b) the report asks «is this an Arabic document?» below it (a low finding, not a high one)

tounicode_gap_ratio.source: declared policy: one unmapped drawn code in a hundred is a high risk; the clean set measures 0, so value = max(0.01, clean maximum)
